title: Ruchira Papers reappoints Vipin Gupta as CFO for five years Ruchira Papers Limited has secured Board approval for the reappointment of Vipin Gupta as CFO & Executive Director for five years, effective November 1, 2026. Concurrently, the Board approved the continuation of managerial remuneration for Co-Chairman Deepan Garg, Director Marketing Ruchica Garg Kumar, and Director Commercial Daljeet Singh Mandhan for one year each. All actions require final shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting
